# wanjaaro.com – Financial Calculators & Tools

> Over 200 free online financial calculators, planners, and educational resources covering taxes, retirement, mortgages, investments, insurance, budgeting, and more. Optimised for US and global personal finance needs.

- [State Income Tax Comparison Calculator](https://wanjaaro.com/state-income-tax-comparison-calculator) – Compare state income tax rates across US states.
- [Tax Bracket Calculator](https://wanjaaro.com/tax-bracket-calculator) – Find your federal tax bracket and effective tax rate.
- [VAT Calculator](https://wanjaaro.com/vat-calculator) – Compute Value‑Added Tax for businesses and consumers (global).
